content.comment_body: Download and installation instructions for the [product_name] software upgrade to [version_no]. The upgrade includes: [product_name] software upgrade, [product_name] web editor, and [product_name] access tool. For installation, you need the predecessor version on your PC or an existing DVD. New features comprise TLS-encrypted program transfer, password protection, improved display, cloud connection wizard, CSV import/export, compatibility with all basic units, and more. The order number remains unchanged; stock will be sold out. Note: A DAMEX check is required to access the free upgrade (see FAQ: Support ID 109744535). New [product_name] Web Editor features include more controls, dashboard options, AWS integration, and TLS-encrypted transfers.
How long does the DAMEX check usually take? I've been waiting 4 days and my customer is also waiting for the program. I can't use the earlier software version with the new hardware.
No one in this forum can give you a definite answer; only [company_name] can. Some users report waiting up to 14 days.

Currently, there are more requests than usual so the DAMEX check is taking longer. We apologize. Remember: after two years you'll be asked to extend your authorization by email; if not confirmed, the check must be repeated. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

It's disappointing—a new software release and new hardware, but you can't access the upgrade to program the devices until authorized. This could encourage users to look for unofficial (and possibly unsafe) sources online.
In my opinion, users are responsible if they try to get software illegally.

I understand the frustration, but there are legal reasons for restricting software access. Some export laws require approval: [url]. As another user mentioned, downloading from unofficial sites is illegal.

Spent hours trying to connect new modules and discovered an update was required. A simple notice about hardware-software compatibility would’ve helped! Now I have to wait for approval before downloading the software, and my customers aren’t happy. What’s the average approval time so I can keep them informed?
Unfortunately, no one here can answer that specific question.
Definitely very frustrating!

I just bought two [article_no] modules and can’t configure them because I’m stuck with my old software version. If a moderator or admin could provide a direct download link, it would be very helpful since I’m unable to proceed with my project and don't have time to wait weeks. Thank you in advance, [user_name].
Moderators can't provide direct download links. The software is export restricted; registration and waiting are required. Sorry, but that's the process.

I bought new [product_name] hardware and the corresponding software, waited two weeks for delivery due to supply issues, then found the old software didn’t connect to the device and always showed an error. After much troubleshooting, I learned through forums that an updated software version is required. Applied for export-restricted access through [company_name]'s system and waited five days, only to be rejected for missing company information. I reapplied and expect to wait again. Thankfully I don't have a client waiting, but if my approval is rejected, the PLC is unusable. I’ll need to switch brands and buy new programming software. Please make it clear that the old software on the DVD doesn’t work with new PLCs unless upgraded.
It's printed on the packaging of the [product_name] module that [product_name] software version [version_no] or higher is required for programming.
I got the direct download link within an hour by contacting the delegate in my country; my supplier provided the contact number.
What number do you mean?
The phone number. English is not my native language.

After the update was released in November, I applied for the download, but technical support asked me to fix several things. By January communication stopped. I have some older controllers remaining but will soon need the new version. The same situation occurred with the previous version release.
What is your question for the forum? What help are you seeking?
No complaints about the products, but just sharing that others have also experienced difficulties with updates—not just myself.
Simply not good enough [company_name]. I need a solution now, so I’m going with another manufacturer today.

Same here—not impressed. I spent 10 hours onsite with no internet, got the wrong update, went back to check, tried again, and only then realized the issue. Very frustrating for both me and my customer.
I may have downloaded from elsewhere—thanks for nothing [company_name]. My account won’t be needed anymore.
Registration typically takes 2-3 days, as stated in the FAQ: [url]. Current laws require this process. Support [product_name].
Good joke...

Many software downloads are export regulated—[product_name] is not a consumer product, so export rules apply. If you’re properly registered in [company_name]'s system and have the download link, access is fast. For first-time registrants (especially private users), export checks can take hours or several days. Notices about required software versions are published with the hardware and on the packaging. If you don’t read this, responsibility falls on you.
Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing considerable frustration due to unpredictable delays from the DAMEX export check required to upgrade their [product_name] software. The waiting period can disrupt project schedules, prevent new hardware from being programmed, and negatively affect customer relationships. Many have noted that restrictive download policies push users towards unofficial sources, posing security risks.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect prompt DAMEX approval, clearer communication about waiting times, compatibility warnings between hardware and software, and immediate access to necessary software after hardware purchase.
